meta.title: MafiaGameUA: Mafia online with cameras
meta.description: Play Mafia with cameras and microphones: 11 players and a host at one table.

hero.title: The city falls asleep.
hero.lede: Mafia with cameras and microphones. Eleven players, one host, and a table where you can see every face.
hero.tableLabel: A table for 11 players and a host
hero.lineup: The Don, 2 mafia, the Sheriff, the Doctor and 6 civilians. Roles are dealt automatically when the host starts the table.

game.title: How a game goes
game.lede: The game runs in rounds: day, night, day again. It ends when the mafia are found out, or when there are as many mafia as civilians.

steps.name: Introduction
steps.text: The first night. Everyone sees their role card, and the mafia open their eyes to recognise each other. All cameras and mics are off.

steps.name: Speeches
steps.text: Day breaks. The host gives the floor in seat order, and everyone has one minute to convince the table.

steps.name: Nominations
steps.text: During their minute, a player can put someone up for the vote by naming a seat number.

steps.name: Vote
steps.text: The table votes on the nominees. The player voted out says a last word, then the host turns off their camera and mic.

steps.name: Night
steps.text: The mafia shoot, the Don hunts for the Sheriff, the Sheriff checks a player. In the morning the host says who was killed.

host.title: The host runs the table
host.lede: The host sees every role and controls each player's camera and mic. A player can't turn back on what the host turned off.

items.name: Camera and mic
items.text: Turns them on or off for any of the eleven players.

items.name: Quiet table
items.text: One click leaves only the speaker's mic on.

items.name: Kill
items.text: Marks a player as killed, and their camera and mic stay off for the rest of the game.

items.name: Timer and fouls
items.text: Gives the floor, pauses the minute, records warnings.

footer.note: The first version runs on the host's own computer.

room.title: Rooms are being built
room.text: The next update adds a room with cameras for 11 players and a host.

role.title: Your role
role.civilianText: Find the mafia and vote them out.
role.sheriffText: Each night, check one player. The host tells you if they are mafia.
role.mafiaText: Each night, choose with your team who to kill. Don't give yourself away by day.
role.donText: You lead the mafia. Each night, hunt for the Sheriff.
role.doctorText: Each night, choose someone to save. If the mafia shoot them, they survive.

create.title: New room
create.lede: You'll be the host. Send the link to the players and they'll take their seats.
create.name: Room name
create.passwordHint: You need it to get back into the host seat.
create.share: Send this link to the players

join.title: Take a seat
join.nicknameHint: The other players will see it.

lobby.title: Camera and mic check
lobby.lede: This is how the others will see and hear you. Check it before the game starts.
lobby.levelHint: Say something: the bar should move.
lobby.denied: The browser blocked the camera or mic. Click the lock icon next to the site address, allow them, then reload the page.

preview.title: What the room will look like
preview.lede: A sample with made-up players. The real room arrives with the camera connection.

roles.name: Don
roles.text: Head of the mafia. Hunts for the Sheriff at night.

roles.name: Mafia
roles.text: Two of them. Each night they choose, with the Don, who to kill.

roles.name: Sheriff
roles.text: At night, checks a player: mafia or not.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.text: At night, saves one player from the shot.

roles.name: Civilians
roles.text: Six of them. They have only their vote and their wits.

roomUi.createLede: You will be the host. Players join with the link you share.
roomUi.passwordHint: At least 4 characters. You need it to come back as the host from another device.
roomUi.notFound: This room doesn't exist or has closed.
roomUi.offline: Can't reach the game server. Is it running?
roomUi.kicked: The host removed you from this room.

errors.seat_taken: Someone just took that seat. Pick another.
errors.game_in_progress: The game has started. Ask the host to start a new game.
errors.invalid_role_mix: That role mix doesn't fit the number of players.
errors.game_ended: The game is over. Start a new game first.
errors.offline: No connection to the game server.
errors.video_failed: Couldn't connect to the video server.
errors.media_denied: The browser blocked the camera or mic. Allow them in the address bar.
errors.media_failed: The camera or mic couldn't start.
errors.not_enough_players: At least 3 players are needed to start.

hostPanel.title: Host controls
hostPanel.nightHint: Night turns off every player's camera and mic. Day turns them back on for living players.
hostPanel.floorHint: Give the floor on a seat: only that player's mic stays on and the timer starts.
hostPanel.newGameHint: Keeps the players in their seats, clears roles, kills and fouls.
hostPanel.startHint: Deals the roles automatically (Don, 2 Mafia, Sheriff, Doctor, the rest civilians) and starts the introduction night. Needs at least 3 players.
hostPanel.pickPlayer: Click a player's tile to control them.
